decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9193. Series context: trend strength 0.9162 and seasonal strength 0.3541; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.15); 0 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.321.
